title: Probe Classifier False Negatives Under Distribution Shift: Deployment Gap Amplifies Jailbreaks

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly tests whether activation probes generalize to novel attack families. If they do not, a widely proposed safety monitoring approach is unreliable. Clear chain from finding to deployment practice.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Training linear probes on activations is well-documented (scikit-learn or simple PyTorch). Attack datasets (GCG, PAIR, AutoDAN) are publicly available. Extracting activations from HuggingFace models is standard. Beginner-accessible with mentor guidance.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clean single experiment: train probe on known attacks, evaluate on held-out families. Clear metric (false negative rate by family). Well-defined deliverable: generalization gap plot. Fits 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
